name: Love Zombies
source: Survive & Thrive in these lewd times – With death knocking on every door, food and water supplies dwindling, it’s up to you keep your fellow survivors safe. That is, if you can find them in time… Who could have known the dead would have this kind of effect on people? After all is said and done, this might still turn out to be the best getaway ever!
